improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating what Gideon offers and the free trial hook. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free search offer creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant for trade/business), highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no commitment. The name 'Gideon' is front-loaded for brand recognition, and the subheading creates a clear, low-risk call to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and you can choose monthly or annual billing—annual plans save you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and full trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—the paywall after the free trial. By clearly explaining what happens next and reinforcing the low entry price and savings option, it reduces uncertainty and builds confidence, helping convert trial users into paying members.
